headline: Elevated risk today; AEMO sees spikes our model does not
summary: Our central forecast averages $95/MWh today, peaking at $153/MWh at 17:45, with a risk ceiling of $280/MWh at the same time, below the $300/MWh spike threshold. AEMO's outlook is much higher, averaging $153/MWh ($58/MWh above our central) with a $616/MWh peak in the half-hour ending 18:00 and 5 half-hours at or above $300/MWh. In backtests AEMO is closer on typical half-hours but sometimes projects high prices that do not happen.
key_points: Risk level is elevated. Today's low is $16/MWh at 10:40 and demand peaks at 7882 MW at 18:35.
Yesterday averaged $203/MWh with one spike interval reaching $23200/MWh.
Tomorrow looks softer: central average $76/MWh, max $106/MWh at 17:25, risk ceiling $166/MWh, despite demand peaking at 10410 MW at 16:50.
Track record over 6 days: normal MAE $29/MWh vs $48/MWh naive; the risk ceiling covered 84% of outcomes. Market regime is similar to the training period.
